description: Configure Screaming Frog SEO Spider to send a custom HTTP request header to simulate bypassing a firewall or accessing a restricted environment. 1) Go to Configuration > HTTP Request > Headers and add a header named 'X-Audit-Token' with value 'SF-Verified-9988'. 2) Configure a Custom Search (Configuration > Custom > Search) to verify the header is received: Search for 'SF-Verified-9988' in the page text/source. 3) Crawl the test URL 'https://crawler-test.com/other/crawler_request_headers' (this page echoes request headers). 4) Export the Custom Search results to '~/Documents/SEO/exports/custom_header_evidence.csv'. SUCCESS CRITERIA: The exported CSV must show a positive match for the token, proving the header was successfully injected and received by the server.
